summary.text: Morgan Bultman is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Carroll 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A Realtor with an MBA from a family with six generations in Ossipee, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she is running to lower property taxes.

paragraphs.text: Bultman earned a bachelor's degree from Georgia State University and her career experience includes working in real estate.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said her family has been connected to the town for over 200 years and six generations, and that she returned to her family home after living in many places.

She described herself as an entrepreneur with an MBA who has run small businesses and lighting showrooms and owned a custom cabinetry showroom, and said she is now a Realtor serving on the Ossipee Economic Development Council.
Bultman said her priority is lowering property taxes by capping assessment increases for longtime homeowners, updating senior tax breaks and fixing home valuation formulas.
She also said she would hold the state accountable for its share of education costs and that she opposes new sales or income taxes.
